name: Film Pop by Leno Cainelli
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
The Film Pop recipe brings out street photography's bold and vibrant side. It amps up the colors and contrast, making everything look rich and lively while keeping that authentic film vibe. The focus is on making your photos pop with color to reflect the vibrancy of the setting you're shooting in. It's perfect for where you want colors to stand out — from urban and street photography to travel photos, celebrations, and fashion shoots — infusing your shots with energy and excitement.
